title: Questions with Ya and Todavía No

sections.content: Use the pretérito perfecto in questions to ask whether an action has happened. Add ya when you expect that it may already have happened: ¿Ya has visto el río? A short answer can be Sí, ya lo he visto or No, todavía no. The question form changes the subject and auxiliary as needed, but the participle stays the same.

items.english: Have you already seen the mountains?
Yes, I have already seen them.
Have they already rented the bicycles?

sections.content: In a short negative answer, No, todavía no is enough. You can repeat the verb when you want a fuller answer.
